title: Restaurant fit-out, Royal Hibernian Way, Dublin 2
role: Design and build contractor, working with the project's design team, Assigned Certifier and fire engineer
summary: Fit-out of BAH33, a city centre restaurant: a glazed terrace enclosure and shopfront, kitchen layouts, a new porcelain floor, a new bar and washrooms, and close-out with the design team.
intro: We have worked with BAH33 through several phases. The first created a glazed, covered terrace along the lane and a new shopfront. A new porcelain floor was laid over the Christmas closure.

Later phases added a new bar with a slatted ceiling and washrooms with timber cladding, both designed by MF. Throughout, we worked with the project's design team, Assigned Certifier and fire engineer on inspections, fire stopping and the documentation needed to close out the works.
scope: New porcelain floor over the Christmas closure
Bar and washroom design and fit-out
Coordination with the design team, Assigned Certifier and fire engineer to close out the works
